adapterRequest.callerIntent: Read private source adapter capability and next-action guidance without executing source reads.

adapters.privacyBoundary: Only caller-approved CSV/JSON fixture paths and sanitized metadata enter build records.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: No watcher exists; freshness comes from explicit caller-provided files.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: No remote rate limit; local checks cap file size and source count.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Build records capture inspected file metadata, rejection reasons, and generated draft paths.

adapters.privacyBoundary: Only mapping decisions and sanitized field names are prompt-visible.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Freshness is inherited from the source manifest being confirmed.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: No remote rate limit; confirmation is a caller-supervised local action.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Handoff records capture whether mappings are proposed, confirmed, or rejected.

adapters.privacyBoundary: No uploaded bytes or private rows enter artifacts because upload intake is not implemented.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Upload recency must be declared by a future runtime; current checks cannot verify it.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Future upload intake must declare size and rate limits before execution.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Future runtime must record approval, upload reference, hash, timestamp, and sanitized errors.

adapters.privacyBoundary: Fixture replay exposes normalized public fixture metadata, not private live connector payloads.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Normal checks use committed fixtures; live freshness is only an explicit opt-in readiness probe.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Normal checks make no network calls, so external connector rate limits are not exercised.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Connector result records capture fixture status, unavailable evidence, and sanitized diagnostics.

adapters.privacyBoundary: No private API credentials, request payloads, or response rows enter generated artifacts.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Future adapters must declare request time, cache policy, and source freshness before forecasting.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Future adapters must declare rate limits and retries before any call is allowed.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Future runtime must record approval, endpoint identity, scopes, timestamps, and sanitized errors.

adapters.privacyBoundary: No database credentials, query text with secrets, or private rows enter generated artifacts.
adapters.freshnessBoundary: Future adapters must declare query timestamp, isolation, and freshness policy before forecasting.
adapters.rateLimitBoundary: Future adapters must declare query limits, timeout, and retry policy before execution.
adapters.auditLogBoundary: Future runtime must record approval, dataset identity, query boundary, timestamps, and sanitized errors.

guards.name: declaration_only
guards.rule: Capability records describe adapter boundaries and must not execute source reads by implication.

guards.name: workflow_source_binding
guards.rule: Adapter source kinds must match the domain-agnostic private setup workflow source kinds.

guards.name: no_secret_storage
guards.rule: Adapters must not store credentials or expose secrets in generated artifacts.

guards.name: normal_checks_offline
guards.rule: Normal checks may inspect fixtures but must not fetch live private API or database data.

guards.name: planned_private_runtimes
guards.rule: Private API, private database, and manual upload adapters remain non-executable until a runtime lands.

guards.name: freshness_and_audit_boundary
guards.rule: Freshness, rate-limit, privacy, and audit boundaries must be declared before setup attempts.

warnings: This is a capability declaration, not a connector runtime.
Private API, private database, and manual upload adapters cannot execute in the current local surface.
No adapter may store credentials or include secrets in forecast artifacts.
Normal checks remain offline and fixture-safe.

outcomeClasses.description: The source kind is available in the local fixture surface and can proceed to the row-specific checked command.
The source kind is fixture-supported only after caller confirmation or approval.
The source kind is declared for future support, but the current local runtime cannot execute it.
The source kind is outside the capability contract and must be replaced before setup.
The source would require credentials, but no credential runtime is implemented in the current local surface.
The source is unsafe for setup and must not enter source intake, forecasting, or scoring.

outcomeRows.agentInstruction: Run the source builder on caller-approved local files, then continue through handoff and intake.
Ask the caller to confirm proposed mappings before treating them as source-intake inputs.
Use policy-bound fixture replay only; do not claim production live evidence gathering.
Do not ingest uploaded data until an explicit upload runtime and approval path are implemented.
Do not request or expose credentials in OPE artifacts; wait for an explicit private API runtime.
Do not connect databases or run queries until an explicit private database runtime exists.
Replace the source with a source kind declared in the private source adapter capability contract.
Reject the source and keep it out of source intake, method gates, forecasts, and scoring.

guards.name: capability_binding
guards.rule: Every declared source kind in the capability contract must have one bound outcome row.

guards.name: workflow_outcome_binding
guards.rule: Every matrix outcome must bind to a private setup workflow outcome class.

guards.name: no_execution
guards.rule: The matrix may recommend next actions but must not execute source reads by itself.

guards.name: no_artifacts
guards.rule: The matrix must not create forecast artifacts, cards, scoring records, or credential records.

guards.name: planned_runtimes_blocked
guards.rule: Manual upload, private API, and private database rows must stay runtime-not-implemented.

guards.name: unsafe_sources_rejected
guards.rule: Unsafe and unregistered sources must not enter setup, source intake, forecasting, or scoring.

warnings: This matrix recommends agent next actions; it does not execute source reads.
Planned private adapters cannot create source manifests, forecast artifacts, cards, or scoring records.
Credentials must stay out of OPE artifacts and prompt-visible records.
Unsafe and unregistered sources must be replaced before setup continues.

bridgeRows.agentInstruction: Run source-builder only for caller-approved local files; continue to handoff before intake or forecasting.
Ask the caller to confirm mappings, then run source-handoff confirmation before method gates.
Use fixture replay for policy-bound auto evidence; do not treat it as production live gathering.
Wait for a checked manual-upload runtime; do not ingest uploads through the current bridge.
Wait for a credential-safe private API runtime; do not request secrets in OPE artifacts.
Wait for a credential-safe private database runtime; do not connect databases through this bridge.
Replace the unregistered source kind with a declared adapter before trying setup again.
Reject unsafe source input and require a safe replacement before any setup step.

guards.name: outcome_matrix_binding
guards.rule: Every bridge row must bind one private source adapter outcome row.

guards.name: checked_entrypoints_only
guards.rule: Runnable bridge commands must point only to checked local OPE commands.

guards.name: confirmation_before_handoff
guards.rule: Manual mapping rows require caller confirmation before source-handoff confirmation.

guards.name: planned_runtimes_non_generating
guards.rule: Manual upload, private API, and private database rows must stay non-generating.

guards.name: no_forecast_or_score_outputs
guards.rule: Bridge rows must not create forecast artifacts, forecast cards, scoring records, or credential records.

guards.name: unsafe_sources_stop
guards.rule: Unsupported and unsafe sources must not enter source intake through the bridge.

warnings: This bridge routes agent next actions; it does not execute source intake by itself.
Only local-file source-builder and fixture auto-evidence commands are current runnable entrypoints.
Manual mapping requires caller confirmation before source-handoff confirmation.
Planned, unsupported, unsafe, and credential-missing rows remain non-generating.
Private source adapter guidance is read-only and does not execute source reads.
Private API, private database, and manual upload adapters remain planned-only until a runtime lands.
Use source-builder or source-handoff only through later checked operations after caller approval.
This guidance does not create source manifests, forecasts, resolution records, scoring records, or credentials.
Private source adapter guidance is read-only and does not execute source reads.
Private API, private database, and manual upload adapters remain planned-only until a runtime lands.
Use source-builder or source-handoff only through later checked operations after caller approval.
This guidance does not create source manifests, forecasts, resolution records, scoring records, or credentials.
